direction_summary.description: One sentence stating the primary field, specialty, and the role of methods.

title.description: The manuscript title, used to exclude the target paper itself from similar-work evidence when testing published papers.

primary_field.description: The manuscript's primary field, as stated in direction_summary.

specialty.description: The manuscript's specialty or sub-field, as stated in direction_summary.

contribution_type.description: Applied finding, method development, dataset/resource, review, clinical study, theory, or another explicit type.

target_audience.description: The research community likely to review and use the result.

methods.description: Tools and methods used; do not promote them to the primary field unless the contribution is methodological.

exclusions.description: Plausible but wrong journal communities that should not drive recall.

search_queries.description: Two or three discriminative queries combining object + problem + contribution, not a copied full abstract.

scope_terms.description: Optional English or bilingual scope keywords used to compare the manuscript against journal titles and aims-and-scope pages; also consumed by the local specialist-title recall channel.
